enemy_desc_1: A flickering, bluish fire floats hypnotically before your nose. It tries to lure you deeper into the swamp of damnation!
enemy_atk_1: The will-o'-the-wisp shoots a spark of pure cold energy at your soul.
enemy_desc_2: A vague, formless cloud of mist hovers trembling over the graves. Sometimes it briefly takes the shape of a wailing face, only to fade away again.
enemy_atk_2: The apparition floats straight through you, leaving a shiver of pure polar cold behind.
enemy_desc_3: A translucent female figure with bloodshot eyes floats shrieking toward you. Her nails are like ice crystals.
enemy_atk_3: The Banshee lets out an icy scream that pierces straight through your soul!
enemy_desc_4: A lean, gray creature with long claws crawls awkwardly over a broken grave. He gnaws on old bones and looks with hungry, hollow eyes at your astral form.
enemy_atk_4: The ghoul strikes wildly with his sharp, filthy nails.
enemy_desc_5: You see nothing, but suddenly loose gravestones and bones fly through the air! An invisible force bursts with rage.
enemy_atk_5: The poltergeist hurls a heavy, creaking gravestone straight at you.
enemy_desc_6: With a loud clatter of bones, a skeleton rises from a mound of earth. He carries a rusty shield and wields a broken sword gleaming in the darkness of the underworld.
enemy_atk_6: The skeleton strikes mechanically and without emotion with his blunt sword at your soul.
enemy_desc_7: An empty suit of armor with black smoke escaping from it draws a broken sword. He does not recognize you; he only knows the memory of battle.
enemy_atk_7: The shadow knight strikes coldly with his ghostly sword.
enemy_desc_8: A floating figure wrapped in shreds of a gray cloak looms before you. Wherever he hovers, the grass freezes and the mist instantly dies away. His presence hurts.
enemy_atk_8: The wraith grabs for your throat with an icy, numb hand.
enemy_desc_9: A monstrous phantom with a gigantic, gaping maw emerges from the mist. You feel your own memories and emotions fade as he draws closer.
enemy_atk_9: The creature tries to take a bite out of your astral body to feed itself.
enemy_desc_10: An even larger and hungrier variant of the soul eater looms from the mist. It absorbs all warmth around you.
enemy_atk_10: The creature takes a massive bite out of your spiritual essence!
enemy_desc_11: This creature has no fixed form; it is a walking patch of pure, deep darkness that absorbs what little light is around it. It moves silently and unpredictably.
enemy_atk_11: The phantom envelops you with suffocating, black shadows.
enemy_desc_12: Even in death, this dark mage refuses to give up his powers. His spirit floats in a circle of purple fire and he mutters incomprehensible curses.
enemy_atk_12: The mage fires a beam of pure, bitter phantom energy at your soul.
enemy_desc_13: This creature was once a powerful sorcerer. Now it is a floating skeleton with glowing red points in its eye sockets, surrounded by an aura of pure decay.
enemy_atk_13: The Lich chants a curse that tears at your soul.
enemy_desc_14: A gigantic, terrifying figure armed with a scythe almost as large as Ramius's own. He guards the deepest gates of the realm of the dead.
enemy_atk_14: The sentry strikes devastatingly with his heavy, phantom scythe.
enemy_desc_15: You stand face to face with the ghost of a legendary warrior who once defeated the Dragon. He raises his phantom blade for one final, tragic duel.
enemy_atk_15: The phantom hero attacks with the perfect technique of a grandmaster.
combat_victory: `2You have defeated the phantom! Ramius grants you +{favor} Favor.`w
combat_defeat: `4Your spiritual energy is depleted! Ramius laughs at you personally and takes 2 extra turns.`w
